5_intro1_lesson.interpretation: 0 Intro-1 almost always means the RMP course-code evidence system could not PROVE the relationship — NOT that no Intro-1 professor exists. Only 505 profs (11%) have any RMP Intro-1 course hit and just 182 have a RECENT one, yet 1062 carry the broader teaches_intro_1 signal and 2387 have RMP ratings at all. The proof layer is the bottleneck, not the population.
false_negative_patterns: Professors with RMP ratings but no course tags (adjuncts/lecturers rarely tagged) — invisible to course-code proof
Campuses with a course code but thin RMP coverage (small/regional/CC) — 0 Intro-1 despite real teachers
Departments using non-obvious course numbers the code-discovery missed (493 campuses still 'none')
5_intro1_lesson.reconciliation_recommendation: Layer official schedule-of-classes / registrar section rosters and syllabi (already scoped in Course Intel) as a SECOND evidence source. Precedence: (1) official schedule instructor-of-record for the Intro-1 code = CONFIRMED, (2) syllabus author = CONFIRMED, (3) RMP recent target match = LIKELY, (4) RMP any target hit = POSSIBLE, (5) title/dept heuristic = CANDIDATE. Treat RMP as corroboration, not primary.
